comments.value:
I think you should reach out to Bunny as well on this. I think they should talk to VRChat directly. 

Bunny can also serve arbitrary files from users, so maybe if there is a subdomain wildcard that can only serve files that are processed or analysed by Bunny. Like the reason GitHub is in the image and string loader white list, but not video has to do with m3u8 playlists.

Have you considered using the white list that you can assign for the world? Users would need to have untrusted URLs enabled, but that would get things working in public instances

details:
I am a VRChat world creator and I am currently testing video hosting for music playback in my worlds.

While testing, I discovered that videos hosted through Bunny.net CDN are blocked by the VRChat video player system because the domain is not included in the video player whitelist.

The official whitelist page:

https://creators.vrchat.com/worlds/udon/video-players/www-whitelist/

Would it be possible for the following Bunny CDN domains to be reviewed for inclusion on the whitelist?

*.bunny.net

*.b-cdn.net

*.bunnycdn.com

Bunny.net is a reliable video CDN used by many creators and would provide a stable hosting option for VRChat worlds that rely on video playback for music or events.

Thank you for considering this request. I believe this would benefit many VRChat world creators who rely on video playback for music and events.
title: CDN domains to be reviewed for inclusion on the whitelist
